//: RP2350 partition layout for the ota-flow demo. The bootrom
reads this table to pick between A and B at boot, ranking by
the IMAGE_DEF version baked into each slot.
Layout on a 4 MB Waveshare RP2350-CAN:
0x200000 ..0x2FFFFF (1 MB)  App-B (id 0, linked A-pair of A)
A and B both carry id=0 (matching the pico-examples ota_update
reference). The bootrom uses the `link` field to identify the
A/B relationship; the `id` doesn't have to differ between siblings
and the SDK examples deliberately keep them the same.

unpartitioned.//: absolute family is required by the RP2350-E10 erratum fix
